note: Triennial election of the county council, 1914: polled 28 May 1914 in four divisions; the other seventeen (nineteen seats) returned unopposed. Majority 100. Morrison was the retiring councillor. The Armagh Guardian (8 May 1914) labels Todd N.; "the Nationalists are only fighting one division - Middletown - with a Unionist".
